origin.description: How many ANSI colors the current settings select.
origin.details: cli.num_colors is used first, then R_CLI_NUM_COLORS, then the crayon options, then NO_COLOR. A stream that is not a terminal is 1. Terminal detection follows COLORTERM, tput colors, and TERM.
